description: Free all-ages community festival on the Sorrento Foreshore celebrating the winter solstice. Centrepiece is the ceremonial burning of a handcrafted 6-metre effigy ('Bernie') at 6:30 pm on the bay. Includes fire and light installations, acoustic and main stage music, illuminated Australian animal lantern path, projection art on historic buildings, food trucks, local producer drinks, silent disco, sound healing workshops, roving performers, kids activities, artisan stalls, tarot, face painting, lantern making, and storytelling.
suitableFor: All ages; families; community; cultural visitors
accessibilityNotes: Flat foreshore access; pram-friendly; limited mobility info — check with organiser
weatherDependency: High — outdoor winter night event; dress warmly
nearbyAttractions: Sorrento village dining; Portsea Pub; Ferry to Queenscliff; Point Nepean National Park
suggestedItineraryPairing: Arrive by 4 pm for lantern path; stay for burning at 6:30 pm; dinner in Sorrento village after
internalNotes: Date confirmed Saturday 20 June 2026. Time confirmed 2 pm–9 pm. Effigy burn at 6:30 pm. Free ticketed. Official website live with program details as of May 2026. Shire council page cross-confirms.
